title: Batched beta waves, signal routing, and issue remediation playflow
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Orchestrate a staged beta rollout split into batched waves (Wave A/B/C) with clear signal routing into Engineering/Support/Success queues, a lightweight release-notes cadence tied to wave openings, and a defined playflow for rapid issue remediation and customer communication. This ticket scopes the launch choreography for lighthouse accounts + cohort beta, defines ownership at each gate, and establishes telemetry and success criteria to gate progression to the next wave.

Why now: We have several enterprise lighthouse accounts requiring progressive enablement and predictable SLAs. Past betas suffered from mixed signals, late release notes, and ad-hoc bug triage that slowed adoption. This playflow aims to reduce cycle time to mitigation and improve visibility for GTM/Support during early ramps.

Outcomes:
- Repeatable wave cadence and go/no-go checklist for each wave.
- Signal routing rules (what goes to SRE/Runtime, what goes to SDK/Docs, what goes to Success) with SLAs.
- Release-notes cadence and templated notes synchronized with wave openings.
- Feedback collection contract (prompt sets, telemetry dashboards, scheduled syncs).
- Quantified success criteria to graduate from Wave A -> B -> C.

Stakeholders:
- Product (owner): Aisha Patel
- Eng leads (runtime, infra): Priya Kumar, Daniel Lowe
- QA/Release: Keiko Tanaka
- Developer Experience & Docs: Samir Rao
- Customer Success / Support: Elena Morales, Tobias Chan
- GTM Communications: Maria Gutierrez

Primary deliverables:
1) Wave playbook (checklist + contacts + rollback plan).
2) Signal routing matrix (Slack + Pager + internal ticket tags + dashboards).
3) Release-notes cadence doc + templates in Drive.
4) Feedback intake pipeline (tagged Linear queue + telemetry dashboards).
5) Graduation rubric (latency/cost/error thresholds, adoption, CSAT) and an automated summary for PM review.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Overloaded runtime on Wave A. Mitigation: reserve Dedicated slots and pre-warm KV cache for lighthouse accounts; SRE on-call during first 48 hours.
- Risk: Conflicting priorities across teams for triage. Mitigation: Pre-agreed SLAs and a designated triage owner per domain for each 24h window.
- Risk: Customers frustrated by sparse release notes. Mitigation: Publish a timeline + short-form notes at wave start and a detailed patch note at EOW.

Signal definitions and SLAs (proposed):
- Sev-0 (system-down): notify SRE pager, PM and CS within 5 minutes.
- Sev-1 (functional regression): route to Runtime/Infra channel + create urgent Linear issue within 30 minutes; CS informed within 1 hour.
- Product feedback (UX/Docs): route to DX/docs folder and tag PM+Docs; weekly synthesis.

Acceptance criteria (must be met before Wave B):
- Wave A onboarded: >= 3 lighthouse customers running production traffic for 7 days.
- No regressions exceeding Sev-1 after initial 48 hours.
- Telemetry dashboards show target latency P95 within SLA and token cost variance < 12% vs baseline.
- CSAT >= 4.0 from lighthouse account check-ins.

Notes on release notes coordination:
- Cadence: Wave start short note (What changed, known issues, contact), Daily bullet if any customer-impacting changes, and EOW consolidated notes.
- Owners: PM drafts short note; Docs reviews; Engineering provides changelog + risk summary; GTM approves messaging for external lighthouse comms.
- Channel: Internal Drive + customer-facing via Intercom/template email for lighthouse accounts.

Telemetry & feedback:
- Required dashboards: per-customer latency/cost, per-model error rates, request distribution, failed generations by intent tag.
- Feedback contract: use standardized prompt sets and a shared evaluation sheet (Drive) to collect quality regressions.
